title: VUEO 0.9.4
changelog: White is now the default interface accent.
Appearance adds Lime Green, Ocean, Violet, Amber and Coral accent choices.
Accent changes apply instantly across Material3 and VUEO interactive states.
VUEO Lime Green remains the fixed brand color for the logo and wordmark.
Refined VUEO launcher mark and in-app brand mark.
Carries forward local Profiles and Who's Watching from v0.9.4.
